description: This source file defines a NotificationManager which handles the creation and sending of user notifications in a macOS application. It manages notification permissions, constructs notification content, and schedules notifications with specified priorities.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A struct responsible for managing and sending user notifications, including handling permissions and different notification priorities.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a notification with specified title, body, sound, and optional priority after handling permissions.
